choose.when: SELECT bucket::timestamp AS time, COALESCE(a.cnt, 0) AS count FROM generate_series( date_trunc('hour', NOW() - INTERVAL '23 hours'), date_trunc('hour', NOW()), INTERVAL '1 hour' ) AS bucket LEFT JOIN ( SELECT date_trunc('hour', action_time) AS hr, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM tb_audit WHERE action_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' GROUP BY date_trunc('hour', action_time) ) a ON a.hr = bucket ORDER BY bucket

SELECT bucket::timestamp AS time, COALESCE(a.cnt, 0) AS count FROM generate_series( date_trunc('day', NOW() - INTERVAL '6 days'), date_trunc('day', NOW()), INTERVAL '1 day' ) AS bucket LEFT JOIN ( SELECT date_trunc('day', action_time) AS dy, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM tb_audit WHERE action_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY date_trunc('day', action_time) ) a ON a.dy = bucket ORDER BY bucket

SELECT bucket::timestamp AS time, COALESCE(a.cnt, 0) AS count FROM generate_series( date_trunc('day', NOW() - INTERVAL '29 days'), date_trunc('day', NOW()), INTERVAL '1 day' ) AS bucket LEFT JOIN ( SELECT date_trunc('day', action_time) AS dy, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM tb_audit WHERE action_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY date_trunc('day', action_time) ) a ON a.dy = bucket ORDER BY bucket

mapper.select:
SELECT request_uri_pattern AS pattern, COUNT(*) AS count, AVG(duration_ms) AS avgDurationMs, SUM(CASE WHEN success_state = false THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS errorCount FROM tb_audit WHERE request_uri_pattern IS NOT NULL
AND action_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
AND action_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
AND action_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
GROUP BY request_uri_pattern ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT request_uri_pattern AS pattern, AVG(duration_ms) AS avgDurationMs, MAX(duration_ms) AS maxDurationMs, COUNT(*) AS count FROM tb_audit WHERE request_uri_pattern IS NOT NULL
AND action_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
AND action_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
AND action_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
GROUP BY request_uri_pattern ORDER BY avgDurationMs DESC LIMIT #{limit}
